About this data & how recommendations work

Air quality comes from Open-Meteo / CAMS models; weather comes from Open-Meteo. Data represent regional estimates, not readings from a sensor at your exact location. The seven-day baseline uses valid hourly estimates from the previous seven complete local days.

Outdoor recommendations use US AQI categories, your selected activity and health profile, plus conservative temperature, UV and rain thresholds. Recommended times are daytime hours with lower concern, not a guarantee of safety. This prototype uses rules, not a trained medical AI.

Planning support, not a diagnosis. Follow your clinician’s care plan and local advisories. Health fields stay in memory in this tab and clear on reload; only location coordinates go to environmental data providers.
